issues.where: the whole frame with the camera held at frame 10027: the cloud field over the ocean, the cloud lines along the ridges, the cyclone at lower right
issues.what: across 6 s nothing visibly changes. The cyclone does not turn, the cloud streets do not drift, and the light and haze at the right edge stay fixed, so the world reads as a still picture
issues.fix: give the cloud layer its own slow drift and evolution, separate from the ground, and turn the cyclone slowly. Let the cloud shadows and the sun glint shift

issues.where: the island from frame 9837 to 10027: the ribbed valleys either side of the central steam line
issues.what: at this height the drainage reads as an even, repeating rib pattern, regular enough to look like a skeleton, so the ground stops reading as a real view from orbit
issues.fix: break up the ridge and valley spacing and the valley lengths, and let erosion and vegetation vary more at large scale

issues.what: the apparent climb speeds up sharply here. The crater shrinks to about half its size between frames 9626 and 9647 after a slow stretch at 9583 to 9604, so the pull lurches
issues.fix: keep the altitude curve on one smooth exponential so the scale changes at a constant rate per frame

issues.where: frames 9541 to 9583, the cloud deck round the crater
issues.what: the cloud acts as one flat sheet with a hole that peels away to the edges, not as volume the camera rises through. There is little parallax between the cloud and the crater rim
issues.fix: give the cloud depth and some layers above the camera's start height, so that near wisps pass the far ground

issues.where: the crater lake surface, frames 9578 to 9589
issues.what: the dark water is almost uniform and static, with no visible wind texture or glint change, so the lake reads as a painted fill
issues.fix: add faint wind ripples and a moving specular glint on the lake

issues.where: the cyclone at lower right, frames 9900 to 9942
issues.what: the storm fades in at the frame edge instead of being carried in clearly by the camera move
issues.fix: have it present in the world earlier, so it enters by parallax
